item.title: HIGH SCHOOL BOYS BASKETBALL: Stillwater advances to Class C title game; Tamarac falls in Class B
item.description: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. — Brackets became clearer in the Section 2 boys high school basketball sectional tournament in Glens Falls on Monday. Stillwater Warriors 50, Saratoga Central Catholic Saints 33 Stillwater turned a tight first half into a defensive showcase to secure a 50-33 Class C semifinal victory over Saratoga Central Catholic. The game was knotted at 14 after the opening quarter, and Stillwater carried a slim 28-26 edge into halftime. But the second half belonged entirely to the Warriors.

item.title: NCAA BASEBALL: Siena slugs way to third straight win
item.description: The Siena baseball bats have been fully awakened. After totaling 12 runs over their first seven games, the Saints have now erupted for 38 runs over their past three contests, punctuated by a 20-11 triumph in eight innings over Maryland Eastern Shore in Princess Anne, Maryland. Driven by its offensive outburst, Siena (3-7) has won three straight over just the past 72 hours to wrap its Maryland swing on a high note.
